terminology.V: Repository-maintained executable checks support the stated software scope; this is internal software validation, not independent certification or field proof.
terminology.P: An implemented prototype and bounded verification surfaces exist; stronger production, operational or domain validation remains open.
terminology.R: A repository-backed research implementation exists while important scientific, empirical or product claims remain unresolved.
terminology.standards_reference: A named standard or authoritative method informs the work; conformity is not implied.
terminology.independent_certification: Requires a current external assessment or certificate with an identified competent body and explicit scope.
